name: infeara
description: Twenty-three Infeara expert skills for business, technology, security, audit, legal, marketing, and professional document work — packaged as one ChatGPT and Codex plugin.

interface.longDescription: Infeara packages 23 senior-expert skills into one plugin: chief executive, chief financial, chief technology and chief operating officers; founder and co-founder; marketing, sales, digital marketing (Google Ads and Meta Ads) and content creation; a professional document writer for cover pages, pagination, letterheads and brand typography; research and development, client success, business management and legal; lead auditor, CISO auditor and compliance management; and cloud, DevOps, server, network and cyber security specialists. Each skill supplies the playbooks, templates, quality checklists and guardrails its persona uses, and hands work to the neighbouring skills that own adjacent decisions. The plugin runs entirely on packaged instructions: it makes no network calls, collects no user data, and stores nothing outside the conversation. It does not execute code, sign contracts, file anything with a regulator, or replace qualified legal, financial or audit professionals; outputs are working drafts for a human to review.
capabilities: Brand-compliant documents with cover pages and pagination
